essence: A 3D particle system, and the product's single most important effect. The causal chain is always the same and reasoning about it in that order is what makes it tractable: an EMITTER decides where and how fast particles are born → BIRTH properties fix what each one is at birth (size, life, colour, type) → PHYSICS pushes them around afterwards (gravity, wind, turbulence) → SHADING/compositing decides how they read. Its difficulty is not the number of knobs — it is that the knobs are 7657 flat entries with COLLIDING display names across systems, several legacy duplicates that look live, and hard gates where one param silently makes another inert. Always key on matchName, never on display name.
manifests_as: particles born at the emitter and carried by physics; the look is dominated by Particle Type (what each particle IS), Size/Opacity, and Blend Mode (2=Add is what makes glowing work)

key_levers.name: Particles/sec
key_levers.effect: THE emission rate. This is the live one — see the 0005 trap below. Low tens read as sparse/atmospheric, hundreds as a dense field, thousands as a volume.

key_levers.name: Emitter Type
key_levers.effect: WHERE particles are born. v18 order: 1 Point / 2 Box / 3 Sphere / 4 Light(s) / 5 Layer / 6 3D Model / 7 Text-Mask / 8 Emit from Parent. Grid was REMOVED in v18 — an off-by-one here is the classic silent-empty-render bug. Box/Sphere need Emitter Size to have any volume.

key_levers.name: Emitter Size X / Y / Z
key_levers.effect: the volume particles are born in (Y=0015, Z=0016). With a Box/Sphere emitter this is what turns a dot into a field; the shape of this volume IS the shape of the effect.

key_levers.name: Position
key_levers.effect: emitter position, 3D and expression-driven. Sweeping this with an expression is the real technique for painting a volume (a funnel, a light path) — the emitter draws the shape over time.

key_levers.name: Velocity
key_levers.effect: birth speed along the emission direction. With Direction Spread it sets how fast the field opens up.

key_levers.name: Direction
key_levers.effect: emission direction mode (1 Uniform = all directions, 4 = Disc, others directional). Uniform + low velocity is the drifting-dust default.

key_levers.name: Direction Spread
key_levers.effect: cone width of emission. Low = a beam, 100 = spherical.

key_levers.name: Life (seconds)
key_levers.effect: how long a particle survives — with Velocity this sets how FAR the field reaches. Long life plus any drift accumulates into a fog mound; short life keeps structure crisp.

key_levers.name: Size
key_levers.effect: particle size at birth. Pair with Size Random (0074) — a uniform size reads as artificial.

key_levers.name: Opacity
key_levers.effect: particle opacity; with Opacity Random (0075) it produces the flicker that makes embers/fireflies read as alive.

key_levers.name: Color
key_levers.effect: flat particle colour. NOTE: this only shows if Set Color (0088) is At Birth — see the gate below.

key_levers.name: Particle Type
key_levers.effect: WHAT each particle is (2 = Glow Sphere is the workhorse for anything luminous; sprite/textured types need pack footage). 0026 is a LEGACY DUPLICATE that looks live and is not — always use 0703.

key_levers.name: Gravity
key_levers.effect: constant downward force; NEGATIVE values make particles rise. Rising dust/embers are negative gravity, not upward velocity.

key_levers.name: Blend Mode
key_levers.effect: 2 = Add. Almost every glowing/luminous look needs this; without it particles read as flat matte dots.

key_levers.name: Glow Size
key_levers.effect: per-particle glow RADIUS, as a percentage of particle size (default 300 = the halo reaches 3x the particle radius). This is the skirt that makes a small bright particle read as a large soft orb. Lower it (~100) to keep the glow tight to the particle body.

key_levers.name: Turbulence Affect Position
key_levers.effect: the main organic-motion lever — turbulent noise displacing particles. Scale = 0715 (feature size), Complexity = 0716. GATED by Air Resistance, see below.

key_levers.name: Motion Blur
key_levers.effect: 2 = on. Shutter Angle = 0036; 360 with fast motion nukes the image, 180-200 is the usable range.

key_levers.name: Glow Opacity
key_levers.effect: strength of the PER-PARTICLE additive glow (distinct from any downstream glow effect). It lays a second luminance falloff outside the particle body, re-softening whatever edge the feather leaves. When a critique says particles read as blown-out orbs or luminous blobs, THIS is usually the cause — not a downstream Glow/Deep Glow, which cannot undo a halo the particle itself emitted. Set to 0 for a clean-edged particle.

key_levers.name: Sphere Feather
key_levers.effect: EDGE HARDNESS of the procedural sphere types, as a PERCENTAGE OF PARTICLE RADIUS. At the default 50 half the radius is an alpha ramp, so every particle is a soft luminance bell with no silhouette — measured on a real render: r90/r10 = 0.44. THIS is why particles read as "glowing dots" rather than distinct objects. Lower to 5-10 for a hard circular edge. Because it is a PERCENTAGE, raising Size does NOT sharpen the edge — the profile is scale-invariant (measured: Size 7 gives r90/r10 0.44, Size 9 gives 0.46). Chasing a soft-particle complaint with Size is the classic wrong lever.

key_levers.name: Size Random
key_levers.effect: per-particle size variation. 0 = every particle identical, which reads as mechanical/regular; raise for a natural field.

key_levers.name: Opacity Random
key_levers.effect: per-particle opacity variation — depth and naturalness in a dense field.

gated_levers.name: Wind X / Y / Z and Turbulence Affect Position
gated_levers.effect: Wind (X 0749, Y 0750, Z) and Turbulence Affect Position (0711) are INERT while Air Resistance is 0 — and AE raises a MODAL dialog if you set them anyway, which stalls a headless bridge. This is a physical rule, not a UI quirk: with no air, there is nothing for wind to push against.
gated_levers._probe: verified 2026-07-15; A/B showed a vendor preset was authored with these deliberately inert

gated_levers.name: Color
gated_levers.effect: Set Color defaults to Over Life, which uses a CUSTOM_VALUE gradient that is unscriptable — so a scripted flat Color silently does nothing and AE's default blue gradient shows instead. This produced 19 blue-when-it-should-be-warm renders in the mining batch before it was found. Set 0088 to At Birth first, or use a master-clone that carries the gradient.

gated_levers.name: Emitter Size Y / Z

gate.name: Emitter Size Mode
gate.setTo: the individual-XYZ value (enum unresolved: accepts 1-2, neither revealed Y/Z in a 2026-07-13 probe)

gated_levers.effect: Y (0015) and Z (0016) can be hidden behind the size-mode enum. Same family of gate as Trapcode Form's Base Form Size — set the mode first, then the individual axes.
gated_levers._status: gate identified, exact enum value still unresolved — re-run probe_gates.mjs on tc Particular to settle it

gated_levers.name: Bounce ground plane (settling / accumulation)
gated_levers.effect: Physics Simulations > Bounce gives particles a FLOOR: with Enable Bounce (0690) and Enable Ground Plane (0875) on, falling particles collide with a horizontal plane at Ground Height (0878, % of frame, default 60) instead of falling out of frame. Bounce Strength (0882, default 50) is how live the bounce is — LOW values make particles settle and pile visually, which is what '积雪/accumulation' asks for; Bounce Random (0883) varies it; Slide Friction (0884, default 80) stops the settled ones sliding. Pair with small positive Gravity (0017) and, for sideways drift, Wind X (0749). Artist-validated in the UI 2026-07-21 (defaults + the two enables were sufficient); SCRIPT settability of these params is not yet probed — if a write throws, hand off with the checkbox names instead of guessing.

unreachable_levers.name: Opacity / Color / Size over Life curves
unreachable_levers.why: CUSTOM_VALUE properties. setValue cannot reach them at all — confirmed 2026-07-13. The ONLY routes are a master-clone (copyToComp transfers full plugin state including curves) or an .ffx preset. Do not plan a look that depends on an over-life gradient without one of those.

unreachable_levers.name: Emitter Type Old
unreachable_levers.why: LEGACY 1..10 popup that looks exactly like a live emission control and is not. Historical notes in this repo treated it as particles/sec and were WRONG — the myth was busted 2026-07-19. 0146 is the live rate. Never write 0005.

unreachable_levers.name: Particle Type (legacy)
unreachable_levers.why: hidden legacy duplicate of Particle Type; 0703 is live.

config_recipes.drifting dust / atmosphere: Emitter Box (0782=2) with a large Emitter Size, Particles/sec 40-120, Velocity 10-40, Direction Uniform (0113=1), Life 6-15, Size 2-5 with Size Random 40-70, negative Gravity for rise, Blend Add (0069=2)
config_recipes.embers / fireflies: as above plus Opacity Random (0075) 50-80 for flicker, warm Color with Set Color=At Birth, Glow Size 200-400, short-ish Life 3-6
config_recipes.snow: Box emitter spanning wider than frame, positive Gravity (small), Velocity low, Air Resistance up so Wind Y can drift it sideways, Size Random high, NO Add blend (snow is opaque, not luminous)
config_recipes.sparks / burst: Point emitter, high Velocity 400-1200, Direction Spread wide, very short Life 0.4-1.2, Motion Blur on with Shutter ~180, Add blend. Bursts need a psec SPIKE over time (expression), not a constant rate — a constant rate reads as a fountain
config_recipes.trail / light path: Point emitter with an EXPRESSION on Position (0581) sweeping the path; Velocity low so particles stay where they were born; Life tuned to how long the trail should persist
config_recipes.volume painting (funnel, tornado, ring): the emitter SWEEPS the shape via a Position expression — angle from time, radius from height. High sweep rate plus turbulence fuses the discrete passes into a wall. This is the real technique; there is no vortex force
config_recipes.settling snow / 积雪 (snow that lands and: the falling-snow recipe above PLUS the bounce floor: Enable Bounce 0690=1, Enable Ground Plane 0875=1, Ground Height 0878 to where the ground should read (default 60% worked), Bounce Strength 0882 LOW (≤20 reads as settling, 50 default visibly bounces), Slide Friction 0884 high (default 80), small positive Gravity 0017 (≈20), Wind X 0749 for drift. Long particle Life so landed flakes persist; consider pre-run so the ground is already dusted at frame 1. Do NOT fake the ground with a separate Fractal Noise solid — the particles themselves can land (measured: the FN-ground plan scored 4/10 and read as a texture bar, log §F.2).

reasoning_hooks: Reason in causal order — emitter → birth → physics → shading. A wrong look is almost always wrong at one specific stage, and naming the stage narrows 7657 params to a handful.

There is NO vortex/orbit force. Particles do not orbit. World Rotation (0291) is a rigid render-time transform, not an angular force — spinning the world rotates a line emitter like a clock hand and particles gain no persistent orbit. Anything circular is painted by sweeping the emitter.
Particular renders onto TRANSPARENCY and ignores its host layer's content — always put a background solid underneath or the frame reads wrong.
Display names COLLIDE across systems (main Size 0027 vs aux Size 0154). Only matchNames are safe.
Set params one at a time with try/catch and read back: a batch set dies silently on the first hidden param.

Aux Systems were replaced in v18 by 'Emit from Parent' on a SECOND system. The legacy 0148-0160 aux group is dormant compatibility and probing it will look inert forever. System existence is plugin-private state that scripting cannot create — but it DOES survive a master-clone.
First instantiation in a fresh project can exceed 120s (licence check) — budget the timeout accordingly.

STAGE DISCIPLINE: emitter -> birth -> physics -> SHADING. A complaint about what ONE PARTICLE LOOKS LIKE (dots not bubbles, blown orbs not flakes, hard not soft) is a SHADING-stage defect and can only be fixed by shading-stage levers: 0703 Particle Type, 0029 Sphere Feather, 0216 Glow Opacity, 0215 Glow Size, 0069 Blend Mode. Emitter/physics levers (0146 Particles/sec, 0749 Wind, 0711 Turbulence, 0581 Position) move particles around and CANNOT change what one of them looks like. Measured: a tune that answered "reads as dots not bubbles" with Wind X, Turbulence and Particles/sec across three iterations scored 7, 7, 7 while the shading stage sat untouched at its defaults.
grounding: Every matchName here is verified against this repo's own live 7657-param dump (gap-test/particular_params_fixed.tsv) and cross-checked against the 135 distinct params used by shipped, rendered recipes. The gates and traps are all empirical findings from this lab's own runs, with dates.
